GRADE 9 INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Time: 56 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Structure of the atom in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the structure of the atom,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

2. About Structure of the atom around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. determine the mass number of elements,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

3. About Structure of the atom in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams,
   B. Learners should ignore Structure of the atom completely.
   C. Structure of the atom is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Structure of the atom.

5. About Metals and Alloys in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the physical properties of metals,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

6. About Metals and Alloys around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the composition of alloys,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

7. About Metals and Alloys in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the uses of metals and alloys in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Metals and Alloys completely.
   C. Metals and Alloys is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Metals and Alloys.

9. About Water hardness in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the physical properties of water,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

10. About Water hardness around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. distinguish between hard and soft water in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

11. About Water hardness in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. apply methods of softening hard water in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Water hardness completely.
   C. Water hardness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Water hardness.

13. About Nutrition in animals in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline modes of nutrition in animals,
   B. Learners should ignore Nutrition in animals completely.
   C. Nutrition in animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Nutrition in animals.

14. About Nutrition in animals around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the structure and functions of different types of teeth,
   B. Learners should ignore Nutrition in animals completely.
   C. Nutrition in animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Nutrition in animals.

15. About Nutrition in animals in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. classify animals based on their dentition,
   B. Learners should ignore Nutrition in animals completely.
   C. Nutrition in animals is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Nutrition in animals.

17. About Reproduction in plants in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. outline functions of parts of a flower,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in plants completely.
   C. Reproduction in plants is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in plants.

18. About Reproduction in plants around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. describe pollination in plants,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in plants completely.
   C. Reproduction in plants is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in plants.

19. About Reproduction in plants in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. outline the adaptations of flowers to wind and insect pollination,
   B. Learners should ignore Reproduction in plants completely.
   C. Reproduction in plants is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reproduction in plants.

21. About The Interdependence of Life in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the biotic and abiotic factors of the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore The Interdependence of Life completely.
   C. The Interdependence of Life is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Interdependence of Life.

22. About The Interdependence of Life around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. construct food chains and food webs in the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore The Interdependence of Life completely.
   C. The Interdependence of Life is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Interdependence of Life.

23. About The Interdependence of Life in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the effect of human activities on the environment,
   B. Learners should ignore The Interdependence of Life completely.
   C. The Interdependence of Life is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Interdependence of Life.

25. About Curved mirrors in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. describe types of curved mirrors,
   B. Learners should ignore Curved mirrors completely.
   C. Curved mirrors is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Curved mirrors.

26. About Curved mirrors around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. draw ray diagrams to locate images formed by concave and convex mirrors,
   B. Learners should ignore Curved mirrors completely.
   C. Curved mirrors is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Curved mirrors.

27. About Curved mirrors in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the characteristics of images formed by concave and convex mirrors,
   B. Learners should ignore Curved mirrors completely.
   C. Curved mirrors is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Curved mirrors.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Structure of the atom in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Metals and Alloys in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Water hardness in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Nutrition in animals in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Reproduction in plants in your school compound.

24. Give two examples of how you can use The Interdependence of Life in your school compound.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Curved mirrors in your school compound.
